item.projecthero.helmet_of_fate.tip: Nabu, Lord of Order, waits inside. Carry it and press V to wear it.
item.projecthero.ankh_charm.tip: Nabu's reward for keeping Order. Right-click to quiet him (-25 Dominion).
message.projecthero.doctor_fate.title: Doctor Fate
message.projecthero.doctor_fate.subtitle: You serve Order now
message.projecthero.doctor_fate.acquired: Nabu accepts you. The Helmet of Fate is yours to wear.
Press V to put the helmet on or take it off. Watch the Dominion gauge: the longer you wear it, the more Nabu takes over. Double-tap Space to fly with it on. The Guidebook (DC) explains everything.
message.projecthero.doctor_fate.refuse_p: You step back. The Helmet of Fate stays on its pedestal.
message.projecthero.doctor_fate.refuse_h: You lower the helmet. Nabu waits.
message.projecthero.doctor_fate.cant_rem: Nabu won't let you take the helmet off.
message.projecthero.doctor_fate.lockout: The helmet won't go back on yet (%s s).
message.projecthero.doctor_fate.no_helme: You need the Helmet of Fate with you.
message.projecthero.doctor_fate.needs_he: That takes the Helmet of Fate.
message.projecthero.doctor_fate.fizzle: Nabu stays your hand. The spell fizzles.
message.projecthero.doctor_fate.possesse: The Lord of Order has taken your body. Mash SPACE to struggle.
message.projecthero.doctor_fate.released: Nabu lets go. The helmet falls from your head.
message.projecthero.doctor_fate.charm: The charm glows. Nabu goes quiet.
You were chosen. Do not waste it.
Every helm has worn many heads.
Not the villagers. Never the villagers.
I know these creatures better than you.
You need me more than you know.
Your hands are mine as much as yours.
We speak with one voice now.
The undead offend me. End them.
Rest. I will carry the spell.
Closer to Order. Closer to me.
This body was always meant for Order.
Take off the helmet, if you still can.
You fought well. It is over.
Nabu pours Order into you. You will live... his way.
Order's command: banish %s creatures of Chaos before dawn.
Order is kept. Nabu loosens his grip and leaves you an Ankh Charm.
Dawn breaks with Chaos still loose. Nabu tightens his grip.
Nabu says yes. He always says yes.
You refuse. Nabu will remember, and his next offer will be meaner.
screen.projecthero.doctor_fate.bargain.m: You refused him %s time(s) today, so he's raised both the price and the reward.
screen.projecthero.doctor_fate.bargain.d: Accept: full health and a golden shield of %2$s hearts, but Dominion +%1$s. Refuse: nothing happens.
screen.projecthero.doctor_fate.bargain.o: Banish (or kill) %1$s creatures of Chaos before dawn: the undead, Nether and End creatures. Succeed: Dominion -%2$s and an Ankh Charm. Fail: Dominion +%3$s.
screen.projecthero.doctor_fate.bargain.f: "You want the Avatar of Order? Then let me in."
Accept: a 40-block golden projection of Doctor Fate rises behind you for 12 s. Its hand slams on your attack keys and it stops projectiles near you. Afterwards your Dominion is at least %s.
screen.projecthero.doctor_fate.serve.bod: A voice fills the tomb: Nabu, Lord of Order. Wear his helmet and you'll be one of the strongest sorcerers alive, but the power is his, not yours, and he wants your body. Accepting replaces your current Primary power. Refuse and the helmet stays here for someone else.
hud.projecthero.doctor_fate.title: Doctor Fate
projecthero.doctor_fate.ability.flight.d: Helmet on: golden-ankh hover flight, cloak billowing. 14 blocks a second, 28 sprinting, a still hover with no keys. Double-tap Space again to drop.
projecthero.doctor_fate.ability.ankh_bol: A golden ankh-shaped bolt: 10 damage and it passes through one creature. +1 Dominion. Without the helmet: 5 damage, no pierce.
projecthero.doctor_fate.ability.golden_c: Glowing chains from the ground bind the target for 3 s (bosses 1 s) and deal 6 damage. +3 Dominion.
projecthero.doctor_fate.ability.ankh_shi: Hold: a giant golden ankh in front of you blocks everything from the front and reflects projectiles. +1 Dominion a second. Without the helmet: 3 s at most, blocks 60% and stops projectiles.
projecthero.doctor_fate.ability.banishme: Opens an ankh gate under the target. Normal mobs are banished (gone, no drops). Strong mobs, named or tamed ones and players are thrown 40 blocks away. Bosses are immune. +12 Dominion, 20 s cooldown.
projecthero.doctor_fate.ability.glyph_st: A 3 s rain of golden hieroglyph blades in a 7-block circle where you look, 4 damage per hit to every threat inside. +8 Dominion.
projecthero.doctor_fate.ability.avatar_o: Asks Nabu first. If you accept, a 40-block golden projection of Doctor Fate rises behind you for 12 s: R, Z and C make its giant hand slam where you look (40 damage, 8 blocks) and it stops projectiles near you. Dominion goes to 90+. 3 min cooldown.
projecthero.doctor_fate.ability.ankh_ste: Blink through a small golden ankh portal 12 blocks along your look (6 without the helmet).
projecthero.doctor_fate.ability.gate_dro: Opens a portal under the target and its exit 15 blocks above it. It falls and takes fall damage, and you blink beside where it lands. Bosses are too heavy. +5 Dominion.
projecthero.doctor_fate.ability.order_bl: A cone of golden force: 14 damage and big knockback. +4 Dominion.
projecthero.doctor_fate.ability.ward_of_: A 6-block golden glyph circle for 10 s. Hostile projectiles and potions inside fizzle, and you and your squadmates in it take 30% less damage. +10 Dominion.
projecthero.doctor_fate.ability.helmet.d: Put the Helmet of Fate on or take it off (1 s). You must carry it. You can't take it off during a Possession, and it won't go back on for 60 s after one.
projecthero.doctor_fate.ability.sight_of: 10 s: every creature within 64 blocks glows (Chaos red, Order gold, neutral white) and you see its health. +6 Dominion.
projecthero.guide.doctor_fate.body: The Helmet of Fate makes you one of the strongest magic users in the world, but it isn't your power. Nabu, the Lord of Order inside it, wants your body. The longer and harder you use it, the more he takes over. You're always choosing between more power and more control.
projecthero.guide.doctor_fate.getting.bo: Find the Tomb of Nabu: a small weathered sandstone pyramid in the desert (rare) with a burial chamber beneath it, guarded by mummy-wrapped Tomb Guardians. Use the pedestal at the back and Nabu asks "Will you serve Order?". Accept and the helmet is yours (it replaces your Primary power). Refuse and it stays on the pedestal for someone else. Random serums never give it.
projecthero.guide.doctor_fate.helmet.bod: Without the helmet you have Kent Nelson's own magic: weak R, G and X only, normal health, and Dominion drains. Wearing it: 40 health, 30% damage resistance, flight (double-tap Space), immunity to Wither and Poison, and every spell at full strength. You also wear the golden helmet, the Cloak of Destiny and the Amulet of Anubis. The amulet lets you see Nabu's gauge even with the helmet off. Keep the helmet in your inventory: if it leaves, it comes off.
projecthero.guide.doctor_fate.dominion.b: The Dominion Gauge shows Nabu's control, Order gold creeping over your blue. It rises slowly while you wear the helmet, with every spell (bigger spells raise it more) and with every bargain you accept. It falls while the helmet is off. Dominion is saved per player. An Ankh Charm takes 25 off.
projecthero.guide.doctor_fate.tiers.body: 0-24 Whispers: faint golden lines, nothing else. 25-49 Override: 1 in 6 attack spells comes out as the spell Nabu prefers, and he won't let you hurt villagers, golems or tamed animals (the spell fizzles). 50-74 Pull: your aim drifts gently toward creatures of Chaos (Nether mobs, the undead, End mobs, Raven at Rage), spells cost 10% less, and your chat gets a gold [Nabu] tag. 75-99 Taking hold: gold at the screen's edges, your movement keys sometimes lag, spells cost health too, and you heal twice as fast. Each tier keeps the ones below it.
projecthero.guide.doctor_fate.possession: Nabu takes your body for 15 s. He flies and casts on his own at the strongest hostile nearby, with huge damage, and you can only watch. Mash Space to struggle: each press shortens it. Afterwards the helmet falls off by itself and can't go back on for 60 s, and Dominion settles at 70.
projecthero.guide.doctor_fate.bargains.b: Nabu offers deals on a small two-button screen that doesn't pause the game. You have 10 s to choose, and ignoring one counts as refusing. Death's door (3 hearts or fewer): full heal and a golden shield for +35 Dominion. Order's command (sometimes at night): banish 5 creatures of Chaos before dawn for -30 Dominion and an Ankh Charm, or +40 if you fail. Forbidden spell: Shift+Z always asks first, and Nabu always says yes, but Dominion goes to 90+. Each refusal makes his next offer that day meaner: bigger reward, bigger cost.
projecthero.guide.doctor_fate.fair.body: Possession never attacks squadmates. On a server you can't be possessed inside spawn protection. Banishment never deletes bosses or players.
projecthero.guide.doctor_fate.commands.b: Operators: /projecthero power tune doctor_fate dominion <0-100>, cooldowns (also clears the helmet lockout), possess, bargain <1 death's door | 2 Order's command | 3 forbidden>.
